title.narrative: Securing Tomorrow

description.narrative: Enhance the digital security capacities of investigative journalists, fact-checkers, human rights defenders, media outlets, and civil society organizations.Foster a collaborative and resilient community of digital safety advocates.Raise awareness and best practices around digital safety, AI-related threats, and organizational risk management.Publish high-impact investigative reports addressing critical digital security issues.

The rapid evolution of digital threats has highlighted the critical need for robust safety and security measures, particularly for investigative journalists, human rights defenders, and media organizations. Over the years, ARIJ and JOSA have pioneered efforts to address these challenges, fostering secure practices and enhancing resilience in Jordan's media landscape.Building on past successes, this project aims to expand digital security training and community-building initiatives, equipping stakeholders with tools to navigate and mitigate emerging risks while promoting collaboration and sustainability in the digital safety ecosystem.

activity-date.narrative: By the conclusion of “Securing Tomorrow: Advancing Digital Safety, Security, and Resilience,” ARIJ and JOSA successfully enhanced the digital resilience of journalists, fact-checkers, youth, CSOs, and human rights defenders in Jordan. The project delivered fellowships, 67 personalized digital security clinics, university and community trainings, organizational support for four CSOs, and regional advocacy engagements. These efforts resulted in stronger individual capacities, the adoption of new digital security policies by partner organizations, and improved awareness of technology-facilitated risks. The project has left a sustainable impact by building skills, networks, and frameworks that continue to protect and empower vulnerable groups beyond the project’s lifetime.

Securing Tomorrow: Advancing Digital Safety, Security, and Resilience” is a joint initiative by ARIJ and JOSA to strengthen digital resilience in Jordan. The project empowers journalists, fact-checkers, civil society organizations, youth, and human rights defenders through fellowships, digital security clinics, tailored organizational support, and public awareness activities. It combines hands-on training, technical mentorship, and policy engagement to address emerging digital threats, promote safe practices, and foster sustainable resilience at individual, organizational, and community levels.
